criteria.text: GET /auth/google/mobile-begin creates a <=5 minute bound transaction and redirects to Google with the existing web client, exact HTTPS callback, login-only scopes, nonce, select_account, secure cookie, and security headers.
The begin route rejects malformed challenge method, PKCE challenge, app state, caller-controlled return URL behavior, oversized input, and rate excess.

The existing callback dispatches namespaced mobile state without malformed or expired mobile state falling through to legacy integration, and validates transaction, browser binding, state, and one-time use before exchange.
The broker verifies Google ID-token signature boundary, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce, verified email, sub, and azp, reuses account authorization, and stores no Google integration credentials.
Success redirects only a random opaque handoff and original app state to the fixed rhythmagents callback, then mobile-redeem returns exact sessionToken and user with no-store/no-referrer.

Redeem validates bounded exact inputs, S256, expiry, success state, and synchronously consumes the handoff before creating a session so concurrent redeems issue exactly one session; a retry after an ambiguous consumed response must begin a fresh login.
Legacy Google integration callback behavior is unchanged.

OAuth transaction and handoff state is process-local, bounded, cryptographically opaque/hashed, cleaned opportunistically and periodically, and missing state after process restart fails closed with a retryable begin-fresh-login error and no session.
Begin and redeem endpoints are bounded and rate-limited and never reflect or log tokens, authorization codes, PII, or oversized secret input.
An env-gated live sandbox HTTP test proves real route, cookie, deep-link, and redeem behavior through the API using a controlled fake Google boundary without calling real Google.
